user.title: Set up Beatify
user.description:
Beatify is a party game integration for Home Assistant that plays music through your media players.

{warning}

init.title: Beatify options
init.description: Advanced authentication settings. Leave these at their defaults unless you know you need them.

data.enable_companion_auth_bypass: Enable HA Android Companion auth bypass

data_description.enable_companion_auth_bypass: OFF by default. When on, requests from the HA Android Companion app on your local network are treated as the host without a login. This weakens authentication and should stay OFF unless the Companion app genuinely cannot authenticate. Do NOT enable it if Beatify is reachable through Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) or any reverse proxy (nginx, Traefik, Caddy, …): the bypass is unsafe behind a reverse proxy. Beatify refuses it for requests that carry forwarding headers or come from a configured trusted proxy, but a proxy that hides itself could still let an internet visitor host games without credentials.

pause_game.name: Pause game
pause_game.description: Pauses the running Beatify game and shows the reason on the TV and every phone. Called while the host already paused, it changes the announcement.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: What the room reads on the pause screen. Leave empty for a plain "Pause".

resume_game.name: Resume game
resume_game.description: Resumes a paused Beatify game where it stopped.

next_round.name: Next round
next_round.description: Ends the round that is playing (reveal), or starts the next round from the reveal. On the last round's reveal it ends the game.

end_game.name: End game
end_game.description: Ends the running Beatify game and shows the podium.

unknown_pause_reason.message: Unknown pause reason. Use food, door or away.

pause_not_host.message: The game was paused by Beatify itself (for example a speaker error). Fix that and resume instead.

no_round_to_pause.message: There is no round to pause right now.

pause_failed.message: The game could not be paused.

resume_failed.message: The game could not be resumed.

cannot_advance.message: The game cannot move to the next round right now.

cannot_end_now.message: The game cannot be ended right now.
